meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize post-signup onboarding, user activation, first-run experience, or time-to-value. Also use when the user mentions "onboarding flow," "activation rate," "user activation," "first-run experience," "empty states," "onboarding checklist," "aha moment," "new user experience," "users aren't activating," "nobody completes setup," "low activation rate," "users sign up but don't use the product," "time to value," or "first session experience." Use this whenever users are signing up but not sticking around. For signup/registration optimization, see signup. For ongoing email sequences, see emails.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化注册后的首次使用流程,提升用户激活率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用户注册后留不住,不知道如何优化激活环节
copy.tagline_en: Optimize the first-run experience to boost activation and retention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users sign up but don't activate and you need to improve the first-run experience.

howto.what: Claude 会排查注册后的引导流程:先读产品背景,再看每一步的流失,指出用户未激活的原因并给出改进方案。产出包括问题清单(含优先级)、新流程设计、新手清单文案、空状态文案、邮件触发时机和指标计划。
howto.when: 当你想优化注册后的引导流程、提升用户激活率或首次使用体验,或用户注册后留不住时触发。也响应 “onboarding flow”“activation rate” 等关键词。注册页优化另见 signup,邮件序列另见 emails。

say.text: 新用户注册完就走,帮我审计一下 onboarding 流程
say.note: 它会给出一份问题清单和改进建议

say.text: 设计一个新手引导流程,让用户尽快用上核心价值
say.note: 它会产出从注册到激活的流程设计

say.text: 怎么找到用户的 aha moment?
say.note: 它会帮你定义激活事件和对应指标

howto.what_en: Optimizes post-signup onboarding: reviews product context and the activation funnel, finds why users churn, recommends fixes. Outputs: prioritized audit, flow design, checklist/empty-state copy, email triggers, metrics plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to improve post-signup onboarding, activation, or first-run experience, or mention phrases like 'onboarding flow' or 'activation rate'. Not for signup-page or ongoing-email work.

say_en.text: New users sign up but don't stick around. Audit my onboarding.
say_en.note: Returns a prioritized list with fixes.

say_en.text: Design a first-run flow so users hit value fast.
How do I find the aha moment for my product?
say_en.note: Helps define the activation event and metrics.
